consequence.statement: Existing Composition resources without these fields continue to work unchanged; the fields are available for optional use in new or updated Compositions.

original.statement: New optional fields spec.pipeline[].requirements and its subfields (requiredResources, apiVersion, kind, matchLabels, name, namespace, requirementName) have been added to the apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1 Composition schema.

decision.reason: The CRD validators confirm that spec.pipeline[].requirements and its sub-fields exist only in the target-release Composition v1 schema [ev-a3bca45d2477], not in the earlier one [ev-b12db1ba30d3]. So this is a purely additive field. The canonical validator confirms the added/none rule: a newly added field has no consequence for existing environments. No evidence says anything fails, is rejected or changes behaviour for Compositions that don't use the field, so the right answer is "none", which makes it informational.
